# Saturday 12 June: our wedding day

## Timeline

- 11:00 Hair and make-up at the cottage
- 13:30 Guests arrive at Foxglove House and take their seats on the lawn
- 14:30 Ceremony on the lawn
- 15:15 Drinks and photos on the terrace
- 17:00 Wedding breakfast in the marquee (64 guests, caterer: Hob & Larder)
- 19:30 Cake, then speeches
- 20:30 First dance, with the band The Larkspurs
- 23:30 Last song. The one taxi is booked for midnight

## Practical

- Lawn chairs come from the hire firm on Friday at 4pm.
- The marquee is booked from Friday to Sunday.
- Ceremony music is a friend with a guitar, who plays from the lawn.
- The caterer works from a van parked behind the marquee.
